nl.title: Hoe gebruik ik de chatbot-agent naast live chat en tickets?
nl.excerpt: Hoe gebruik ik de chatbot-agent naast live chat en tickets: praktische handleiding in AI-agents, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
De chatbot-agent vult live chat en tickets aan: standaardvragen afhandelen, complexe zaken escaleren.

Samenwerking

  • Chatbot-agent — herhaalvragen en gating.
  • Live chat / Agent 000 — snelle sitehulp en kennisbanklinks.
  • Tickets — storingen, account, diepgang.

Inrichting

  1. Inventariseer top 10 vragen.
  2. Zorg dat kennisbank/FAQ up-to-date is.
  3. Start chatbot-agent volgens planning.
  4. Escalatieregel: bij account/betaling/storing → ticket.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld je pakketnaam, agenttype en status, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Gerelateerd: Verschil Agent 000; supportkanalen.

en.title: How do I use the chatbot-agent naast live chat and tickets?
en.excerpt: Design/custom work on the site: lock the design, build in CMS/theme, test performance and mobile.
en.bodyHtml:
“How do I use the chatbot-agent naast live chat and tickets”: work in the CMS/theme or frontend repo — not in DNS. Ship with backup and visual QA.

Preparation

  • Design source (Figma/specs)
  • Staging or local environment
  • Production backup

Steps

  1. Confirm scope: which page/component and when it may go live.
  2. Build on staging (theme/child theme, page builder or frontend code) per the design.
  3. Check responsive breakpoints, contrast and load time (compress heavy images).
  4. Review with stakeholder; apply feedback on staging.
  5. Deploy to production; purge cache; spot-check desktop + mobile.

Verify

  • Visually matches agreed design
  • No mobile layout break
  • Core flows clickable

Tip: One component per deploy reduces rollback scope.

Note: Building ‘quickly’ on production without staging = high risk.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Staging, cache, accessibility.
